title: Splat Patrol Runner
heading: Splat Patrol
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Aim with the mouse and click the crosshair over a window to splat.

1.name: Open and close
1.note: A forever loop: wait a random time, the raccoon looks out, the window shuts.

2.name: Splat!
2.note: The crosshair gets the click and broadcasts splat; the window under the mouse-pointer is hit.

3.name: A whole house
3.note: The Window sprite puts a clone on every window spot; each clone runs the same script.

4.name: Raccoons splat back
4.note: A raccoon not splatted in time splats you; splashing a villager costs a life too.

5.name: Round after round
5.note: Houses take turns; showTime shrinks and badChance grows. This is the whole game.
